## Post-merge performance receipt — F209 part 1

Deployed merge **`f06f00f56b30f0ea8c7e6e37c37ea5cba283329c`**, daemon **PID68910**; ping reported `commit=f06f00f56b`. Waited until daemon uptime **02:30** before the minute sample. No seat closed/reloaded; `pij-musical-hedgehog` remained open and its process was active.

**Result:** the missing-transcript state lookup is fast; daemon CPU is lower than the earlier observation, but **the roughly<20%CPU target is not met by this part-1 reading**.
